pipeline: PROVIDER → MODEL → CAPABILITY → ACCOUNT → QUOTA → ROUTER → FALLBACK
selection_rule: primary if still executable; else first remaining candidate after policy, validity, authorization, capacity/quota, capability, preferences, lexical sort (provider_id ASC, account_id ASC, model_id ASC); visited keys excluded
unknown_policy: capacity/quota/rate_limit status === 'unknown' → candidate not selectable (unknown ≠ available)
anti_loop: candidate key provider_id|account_id|model_id; primary always visited this call; input.visited excluded
rules: does not execute models or call providers
does not invent permissions or a Policy Engine
does not coerce unknown capacity/quota to available
does not use fallback to evade rate limits, quotas, or policy
no retry engine — one next candidate per call
